id: \bI like you. Have a good day.
en: \bI like you. Have a good day.

it: \bIl Campione? Lotta con me, ti prego.

id: \bHave you been keeping up with the fast-paced battles? I'm supporting Sinnoh.
en: \bHave you been keeping up with the fast-paced battles? I'm supporting Sinnoh.
it: \bStai seguendo le lotte serrate? Io tifo per Sinnoh.

id: \bDo you think I can climb this?
en: \bDo you think I can climb this?
it: \bSecondo te riesco a scalare questa parete?

id: \bI can use the birds to scale the cliff. Why didn't I think of it before?
en: \bI can use the birds to scale the cliff. Why didn't I think of it before?
it: \bPosso usare gli uccelli per scalare la scogliera. Perché non ci ho pensato prima?

id: \bI don't see many people around these parts.
en: \bI don't see many people around these parts.
it: \bNon vedo molta gente da queste parti.

id: \bI'd stay clear of the next town over. Nothing but missed opportunity.
en: \bI'd stay clear of the next town over. Nothing but missed opportunity.
it: \bTe lo dico io, stai alla larga dalla prossima città. Solo occasioni mancate.

id: \rYou don't need to go this way. Why? Well, because.
en: \rYou don't need to go this way. Why? Well, because.
it: \rNon hai bisogno di andare da questa parte. Perché? Beh, perché sì.
